summary: Make Karma browser regression tests synchronize with rebuilt landscape input and accelerated battle completion.

spec.reason: The navigation, battle result, and completion-state acceptance criteria remain unchanged.

design.reason: Only browser-test timing and readiness detection changed; runtime behavior is unchanged.

validation: The rotated home test waits for the visible enabled journey input before tapping it.
The cheer test observes battle completion on each animation frame and freezes the Phaser clock immediately after a real result before checking the disabled completion control.
limitations: Physical iOS and Android devices remain unverified.
